items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: Brother Coleman, he used to live two blocks of me. We were little kids on Arlene Street.

ctx.x: Somebody told us about the other day.
He always had a heavy cough. But, Brother Coleman, he used to live two blocks of me. We were little kids on Arlene Street. He had a privilege to play piano there.
Brother Coleman, imagine. He was Thomas Bell, yeah.
